steps.content: You try your best to break free from the strange creature entangling you. You fall and land in the middle of an empty stage.
After a brief silence, you notice a pair of dim eyes slowly fixate on you. The creature gives off the aura of Mania, yet is unlike any monster you've ever fought.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: You're... the dreamless one...?

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: No... you're just someone... I cannot touch...

options: Who are you? Where do you come from?

steps.content: The shadow doesn't respond as it wriggles up. You smell the familiar, chillingly sweet scent of Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: I feel... its fragments, its carcass... inside of you... The call of the Ring is inside you...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: I can find happiness... I can seize happiness... I can... create dreams, open up a world...

Tentacles creep out from the shadows, prodding and wrapping around you. They turn into tiny mouths to kiss and gnaw at you. Something is seeping into your soul, slowly rotting away your consciousness. It is awakening your purest hatred and fear.
You've been careless. You thought you'd still be fighting against "humans," either Sinners or conspirators related to the Black Ring... You never thought you'd come across something like this.
Searing pain tears at your body and soul. You want to shake them off, but you can't cast your shackles.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Am I... qualified to awaken you...? Am I able... to awaken the Ring...?
The Ring... Is it also a creature from the Black Ring?!
A ray of blue light flashes before you, severing the goo entangling you. The girl lands gently in front of you. With her back toward you, she faces the monster with surprising fierceness.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: ...If you dare touch him, you shall die.
steps.female_content: <color=#396fdc><i>...If you dare touch her, you shall die.</color>

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Grr... Corpus... Corpus... Come to me... Come...
Snap! Another sharp ray of blue light cuts off its outreached tentacles, carving a clear boundary on the ground. The gooey black monster lets out a mournful cry.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: If you cross this boundary, you shall die too.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Now... Go back!

The girl speaks icily, pushing back the monster with her intimidating presence. It finally gives up and writhes on the ground as if surrendering to her. Whimpering piteously, it finally retreats into the darkness.
The suffocating atmosphere disappears. The girl turns to you, pouting and complaining.

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: Audience members shouldn't barge onstage. It's common sense. Those who climbed into the circus cage all got eaten by lions and tigers in the end. Do you want to end up like that too?

steps.speaker: Young Serpent
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Marv</color> is really bad. It'll really eat you when I'm not paying attention.
She pulls you up from the floor.
